SELECT r.review_post_id AS reviewPostId, r.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, r.review_board_title AS reviewBoardTitle, r.review_board_content AS reviewBoardContent, r.review_board_count AS reviewBoardCount, r.review_board_scrap_count AS reviewBoardScrapCount, r.review_board_report_status AS reviewBoardReportStatus, r.review_board_report_count AS reviewBoardReportCount, NVL(l.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, TO_CHAR(r.review_board_regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reviewBoardRegdate, TO_CHAR(r.review_board_update, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reviewBoardUpdate FROM tblReviewBoard r JOIN tblUser u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT review_post_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM tblReviewLike GROUP BY review_post_id ) l ON r.review_post_id = l.review_post_id WHERE r.review_post_id = #{reviewPostId}
mapper.insert: SELECT seqReviewBoard.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO tblReviewBoard ( review_post_id, user_id, review_board_title, review_board_content, review_board_count, review_board_scrap_count, review_board_report_status, review_board_report_count, review_board_regdate, review_board_update ) VALUES ( #{reviewPostId}, #{userId}, #{reviewBoardTitle}, #{reviewBoardContent}, 0, 0, 'A', 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE tblReviewBoard SET review_board_title = #{reviewBoardTitle}, review_board_content = #{reviewBoardContent}, review_board_update = SYSDATE WHERE review_post_id = #{reviewPostId}
